pitch.heading: Why your next holiday belongs in the Pinzgau
pitch.body: Between the peaks of the Hohe Tauern, crystal-clear mountain streams and sun-drenched alpine pastures lies one of Austria's most beautiful regions. Whether it's easy cycling along the Tauern Cycle Path, hikes to welcoming alpine huts, the thunder of the Krimml Waterfalls or ski days on the Wildkogel – the Pinzgau has a favourite moment for everyone. Below you'll find a curated selection of our personal recommendations on tours, nature and culture. Get inspired – and book your stay at our chalet as the perfect base for all these experiences.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: The protection of your personal data is of particular importance to us. We process your data exclusively on the basis of legal provisions (GDPR, TKG 2003).
privacy.contactText: When you contact us via the form on our website or by email, the data you provide will be stored for six months for the purpose of processing the inquiry and in case of follow-up questions.
privacy.hostingText: This website is hosted via Supabase and Lovable Cloud. Server log files (IP address, timestamp, browser) are stored temporarily for security reasons.
privacy.cookiesText: This website uses only technically necessary cookies (e.g. language settings). No tracking or marketing cookies are used.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to information, correction, deletion, restriction, data portability, revocation and objection. To exercise these rights, please contact steinbockchalets@gmail.com.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.bookingText: A booking inquiry via the form is non-binding. The rental contract only becomes effective with our written confirmation.
terms.paymentText: Payment is made according to the conditions stated in the booking confirmation, usually as a deposit upon booking and the balance before arrival.
terms.cancellationText: Cancellations must be sent in writing to steinbockchalets@gmail.com. Cancellation fees depend on the time of cancellation according to ÖHGB.
terms.liabilityText: The guest is liable for damages caused during the stay by themselves or their companions. The landlord's liability for slight negligence is excluded.
terms.jurisdictionText: Austrian law applies. The place of jurisdiction is the competent court in Austria.
